versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Accessibility Audit skill, supporting WCAG 2.2 audits for UI, components, products, or design specs.
- Produces a prioritized checklist of pass/fail assessments with specific remediation suggestions.
- Covers all four WCAG principles: Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, Robust.
- Includes sections for manual and automated testing recommendations, quality checks, anti-patterns, and quick wins.
- Guides users to provide required inputs (what is audited, description/image, WCAG level, assistive tech users, platform).
- Output includes compliance summary, issues categorized by severity, and actionable fixes.
